rows.label: bf02390100_0020
rows.name:
Obtain the Holy Grail... return home...
in triumph...

rows.label: bf02390100_0040
rows.name:
That's what he gets for
trying to execute Nia.

rows.label: bf02390100_0050
rows.name:
No. They were trying to send
me back to the homeland.

rows.label: bf02390100_0070
rows.name:
A trap? Then that notice saying Nia
would be executed was a lie?

rows.label: bf02390100_0080
rows.name:
Boss, that doesn't matter, mo!
Hurry and escape, mo!

rows.label: bf02390100_0090
rows.name:
Master is right, mo.
There's a high chance pursuers will come, mo.

rows.label: bf02390100_0100
rows.name:
Indeed. Let's hurry.
First, we need to get out of town.
